{{Quote|Car Affa is an arms dealer who sells Republic weapons on the black market.|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Lightsaber Lost">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>}}
'''Car Affa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] active on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Legends-Date">{{TCWdates|211}}</ref> Affa profited from selling [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] arms to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] until he was apprehended by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who brought Affa to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for questioning.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />

==Behind the scenes==
Car Affa bears a yellow smiley face on each shoulder of his clothing.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />
